app: the DH Engineering job card app (app code under jobcard-system/: an Electron + React client and an Express + SQLite server)

check.describe: syntax-checks changed server files, builds the client and boots the server on throwaway data

intendedBehaviour: the matching docs/notes/*.md file(s) for this area
permissions: the Roles and permissions section of CLAUDE.md — admin, manager and user (worker); watch pricing, the activity trail, contact details, deleting jobs, admin accounts, system data and status changes. Check what the server actually sends and accepts.

angles.userFlow: the path is screen -> request -> server -> database -> reply -> screen.
angles.badData: every stored moment must be UTC ISO-8601; a history entry missing or not in the {from,to} shape is a bug; a startup conversion that is not idempotent is a bug; archived or invoiced jobs and running timers matter.
angles.awkward: archived or invoiced jobs, a running timer, archived customers and options.
angles.houseRules: saving while the person is still typing or on a timer, a write retried automatically, a pop-up where a field should be marked (or both), a modal setting page scroll itself, a clickable non-button, a suggestion list that loses keyboard behaviour, a missing audit record, inline SQL.

fixStyle: camelCase everywhere in JavaScript; shared rule files in server/src/shared for rules both sides need; prepared statements in database.js; recordHistory with {from,to}; a startup conversion in runLegacyMigrations plus a DATA_VERSION bump if a stored value's shape changes, and the seed scripts updated too.
setup: On the owner's WSL machine never run npm install — node_modules is shared with Windows. In a cloud sandbox, install packages in jobcard-system/server and jobcard-system/client if node_modules is missing.
areas: Pricing sheet (costing) and the job screen
Job details: customer box, suggestion lists, parts, suppliers
Database start-up, upgrades, backup and restore, settings
Management pages: customers, suppliers, users, quality levels, tags, equipment
Sign-in, sessions and who-can-see-what across the whole app
Timers, logged work, overtime, job status
Job list, numbering, search, comments, activity record
Delivery and speed: installer, first start, offline, serving, ~3 years of data
lessons: A fix that creates a new wrong case is worse than the bug: round 4's 'credit reused machine numbers to the right machine' was reverted and asked instead (machine numbers are never reused).
Data-moving startup conversions get extra scrutiny: never delete or overwrite a person's file, retry until a full pass succeeds, stay cheap on a slow network drive, and re-run after a backup restore.
